change_record.title: New strnatcasecmp and natcasesort functions in Drupal\Core\Utility\NaturalSort

description.excerpt: New strnatcasecmp and natcasesort functions in Drupal\Core\Utility\NaturalSort to introduce a generic sort helper for language-dependent string comparisons using a "natural order" algorithm as drop-in replacement for php functions strnatcasecmp and natcasesort . If php intl extension is installed it uses Collator::compare() , fallback to strnatcasecmp() Replace: strnatcasecmp($a_string, $b_string); With: NaturalSort::strnatcasecmp($a_string, $b_string); Replace: natcasesort($array); With: NaturalSort::natcasesort($array);

symbols.semantics: A change record names symbols. It does not, in this contract, assert their lifecycle; that comes from the deprecation index.
